actual_scope: Prove a sharp even-energy Gaussian packing-kernel bound and a smaller sufficient even radix for equal-energy rows.

bottleneck_link: Exact operator equality can use smaller packed integers while retaining every row and absolute phase, under explicit equal-row-energy premises.
stop_rule: Stop at the first proved radix reduction and standalone finite corroboration; do not replay predecessor circuit inventories or extend to an optimal unitary radix.
